'''Touati Benoukraf''' (born 1980) is a computational and molecular biologist. He holds a [[Canada Research Chair]] in Bioinformatics for Personalized Medicine at the Faculty of Medicine of [[Memorial University of Newfoundland]] since November 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Canada Research Chair |url=https://www.chairs-chaires.gc.ca/chairholders-titulaires/profile-eng.aspx?profileId=4334 |website= Profile page}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Faculty of Medicine, Memorial University |url=https://www.mun.ca/medicine/faculty-and-staff-resources/faculty-a-z/benoukraf-touati.php |website=Profile page}}</ref>
His research focus is on [[computational (epi)genomics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Citations Google Scholar |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=VF9fdnEAAAAJ&hl=fr |website= Profile page}}</ref>
